reviews.title: Perfect Lunch Box for My 12-Year-Old Son!
reviews.body: I absolutely love this bento box for my 12-year-old son! The compartments are the perfect size for packing a variety of foods, which makes it easy to create balanced lunches without everything getting mixed together.It's sturdy, easy to clean, and fits nicely in his lunch bag. The lid seals well, and the compartments help keep snacks, fruit, sandwiches, and other items organized throughout the day.My son loves it, and it has made packing school lunches much easier for me. Great quality, practical design, and well worth the purchase. I would definitely buy it again!

features: Tips: The cover image of the packaging box is a teal bento box, but inside is the the correct color bento box you choose. If you have any questions or suggestions after you receive the bento lunch box, please feel free to contact us.
All-in-one: You will get 1 Bento Box, 1 Spoon, 1 Fork, 1 plastic Sauce Jar and 4 silicone Muffin Liners. This bento box set can meet your needs for daily dining accessories.

With 4 Compartments: Bento box adult lunch box has 1200ml / 40oz capacity, with 4 compartments for different kinds of food. Separate compartments to maintain the original flavor of the food. Perfect capacity size is suitable for all ages.
Sturdy Plastic & BPA-free: The bento lunch box is made of premium PP plastic. Thickened material, durable and drop resistant. Just pack food with confidence.

Leak-proof Design: The lunch box's lid has embedded silicone gasket and 4 locking buckle. Each compartment has a corresponding silicone gasket. All-round seal, no worry about food leak out..Microwave & Dishwasher Safe: Bento box's lid and container are separable, and the container can be put in the dishwasher for easy cleaning. The lunch box containers is microwavable, be at ease for heating your meal. (Note: Container part only, without lid.)
